description: This file defines the Language controller class for the OpenCart admin extension system. It manages listing, installation, and uninstallation of language extensions within the admin panel, including loading language files, registering extensions, handling permissions, and rendering the language management view.

classes.name: Language
classes.description: Controller class for managing language extensions in the OpenCart admin system, including listing available languages, and installing/uninstalling extensions.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Default method that outputs the list view of language extensions.

methods.name: getList
methods.description: Loads language files, scans directories for available language extensions, compares with installed extensions, prepares data for the view, and returns the rendered language extension list.

methods.name: install
methods.description: Handles the installation of a language extension, including permission checks, registering controllers/models/views, and calling optional install scripts.

methods.name: uninstall
methods.description: Handles the uninstallation of a language extension, including permission checks, removing from the extension registry, and calling optional uninstall scripts.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Loads and displays the list of language extensions.

methods.name: getList
methods.description: Gathers data about available and installed language extensions, and renders the list view.

methods.name: install
methods.description: Installs a new language extension, setting permissions and registering the extension components.

methods.name: uninstall
methods.description: Uninstalls a language extension, removing it from the system and restoring permissions.
